text: Now we're getting into surreal territory. GPT-3 knows how to have a normal conversation. It doesn’t quite know how to say “Wait a moment... your question is nonsense.” It also doesn’t know how to say “I don't know.” Q: How do you sporgle a morgle? A: You sporgle a morgle by using a sporgle. Q: How many bonks are in a quoit? A: There are three bonks in a quoit. Q: How many rainbows does it take to jump from Hawaii to seventeen? A: It takes two rainbows to jump from Hawaii to seventeen.
